visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Split-screen presentation begins with a top clip showing a coffee spill inside a white plastic bag, while the bottom half features a man with shoulder-length wavy hair in a white t-shirt reacting with a look of concern. (2) The top footage transitions into a hands-on demonstration of twisting a plastic bag around a cup, while the man below reacts with wide eyes and a hand to his mouth in mock surprise. (3) The man becomes full-screen, sitting in an indoor studio environment on a grey couch; he holds a white plastic bag and a white coffee cup, starting to demonstrate the hack himself. (4) He places one cup in the bag, twists the center of the bag twice to create a second partition, and inserts a second black coffee cup, then proceeds to swing the bag vigorously to prove the drinks are secure. (5) Transitioning to a single-cup method, he places a cup in a large bag, twists the bag tightly from the bottom upwards until it wraps the cup firmly, and ties a knot at the top. (6) He swings the single-cup bundle 360 degrees over his head and side-to-side, laughing as he demonstrates it is spill-proof, concluding with a brief outdoor overlay shot of himself on a rainy road holding the same setup.

(3) The speaker shouts 'Oh!' loudly as he swings a bag, demonstrating the success of the hack. The sound of a cup thumping softly against the plastic bag is audible. (4) A digital 'ding' sound effect transitions to the next segment. The speaker's tone becomes slightly more instructional and lower in pitch, followed by rapid rustling as he twists a bag around a single cup. (5) The speaker laughs loudly, and the BGM swells slightly in the mix as he performs a high-speed demonstration of swinging the bag 360 degrees.
